https://enrsi.stvr.sk/articles/news/4536.text: Slovakia has presented the design of its pavilion for Expo 2027 in Belgrade. The national exhibition, themed “Slovakia – a Playground of Opportunities”, will centre on an interactive installation called the “Tree of Opportunities”, showcasing Slovak culture, tourism, innovation and business. During a visit to Belgrade, Slovak representatives discussed preparations for the exhibition and future cooperation with Serbian partners in areas including information technology, healthcare and energy. Expo 2027 will take place from May to August and is expected to attract more than four million visitors. Source: TASR
